arxiv-2101-02652.title: Universality in Phyllotaxis: a Mechanical Theory
arxiv-2101-02652.creator: Hyun-Woo Lee and Leonid S. Levitov
arxiv-2101-02652.description: Abstract Abstract: One of humanity’s earliest mathematical inquiries might have involved the geometric patterns in plants. The arrangement of leaves on a branch, seeds in a sunflower, and spines on a cactus exhibit repeated spirals, which appear with an intriguing regularity providing a simple demonstration of mathematically complex patterns.

arxiv-2208-02144.title: Light new physics and neutrino electromagnetic interactions in XENONnT
arxiv-2208-02144.creator: Amir N. Khan
arxiv-2208-02144.description: Abstract We derive new limits on the neutrino electromagnetic interactions and weakly coupled light vector and scalar mediators using the recent XENONnT data of the solar neutrino-electron elastic scattering. XENONnT has already reported the world’s best constraint on the flavor-independent effective neutrino magnetic moment with almost twice the exposure and improved systematics.

arxiv-2301-01039.title: Brass-Stancu-Kantorovich operators on a Hypercube ∗
arxiv-2301-01039.creator: Gülen Başcanbaz-Tunca, Heiner Gonska
arxiv-2301-01039.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Gülen Başcanbaz-Tunca, Heiner Gonska. We deal with multivariate Brass-Stancu-Kantorovich operators depending on a non-negative integer parameter and defined on the space of all Lebesgue integrable functions on a unit hypercube. We prove L p L^{p} -approximation and provide estimates for the L p L^{p} -norm of the error of approximation in terms of a multivariate averaged modulus of continuity and of the corresponding L p L^{p} -modulus.

arxiv-2304-05001.title: One-dimensional central extensions and simplicities of a class of left-symmetric conformal algebras
arxiv-2304-05001.creator: Zhongyin Xu, Yanyong Hong
arxiv-2304-05001.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Zhongyin Xu, Yanyong Hong. In this paper, we introduce the definition of pre-Gel’fand-Dorfman algebra and present several constructions. Moreover, we show that a class of left-symmetric conformal algebras named quadratic left-symmetric conformal algebras are one to one correspondence with pre-Gel’fand-Dorfman algebras. Then we investigate the simplicities and central extensions of quadratic left-symmetric conformal algebras by a one-dimensional centre from the point of view of pre-Gel’fand-Dorfman algebras.

arxiv-2306-14867.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by . We present two randomised approximate counting algorithms with running time O ~ ​ ( ( n ε ) 2 − c ) \widetilde{O}\left(\left(\frac{n}{\varepsilon}\right)^{2-c}\right) , for some constant c > 0 c>0 and accuracy ε \varepsilon : 1. for the hard-core model with fugacity λ \lambda on graphs with maximum degree Δ \Delta when λ = O ⁡ ( Δ − 1.5 − c 1 ) \lambda=O(\Delta^{-1.5-c_{1}}) where c 1 = c / ( 2 − 2 ​ c ) c_{1}=c/(2-2c) ; 2.

arxiv-2310-14530.title: Mock Observations: Formation and Evolution of diffuse light in Galaxy Groups and Clusters in the IllustrisTNG Simulations Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2310-14530.creator: Lin Tang, Weipeng Lin, Yang Wang, Jing Li, Yanyao Lan
arxiv-2310-14530.description: Abstract In this paper, by analyzing mock images from the IllustrisTNG100-1 simulation, we examine the properties of the diffuse light and compare them to those of central and satellite galaxies. Our findings suggest that the majority of the diffuse light originates from satellites.

arxiv-2310-15546.title: Robust and Deterministic Preparation of Bosonic Logical States in a Trapped Ion
arxiv-2310-15546.creator: V. G. Matsos, C. H. Valahu, T. Navickas, A. D. Rao, M. J. Millican, X. C. Kolesnikow, M. J. Biercuk, T. R. Tan
arxiv-2310-15546.description: Abstract Encoding logical qubits in bosonic modes provides a potentially hardware-efficient implementation of fault-tolerant quantum information processing. Here, we demonstrate high-fidelity and deterministic preparation of highly non-classical bosonic states in the mechanical motion of a trapped ion. Our approach implements error-suppressing pulses through optimized dynamical modulation of laser-driven spin-motion interactions to generate the target state in a single step.

arxiv-2402-13520.title: Fractal scaling and the aesthetics of trees
arxiv-2402-13520.creator: Jingyi Gao, Mitchell Newberry
arxiv-2402-13520.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jingyi Gao, Mitchell Newberry. Trees in works of art have stirred emotions in viewers for millennia. Leonardo da Vinci described geometric proportions in trees to provide both guidelines for painting and insights into tree form and function. Da Vinci’s Rule of trees further implies fractal branching with a particular scaling exponent α = 2 \alpha=2 governing both proportions between the diameters of adjoining boughs and the number of boughs of a given diameter.

arxiv-2408-01987.title: Diagonally forced systems and the spectral signature of matrix cycles
arxiv-2408-01987.creator: Michael A.S. Thorne British Antarctic Survey
arxiv-2408-01987.description: Abstract Given any square matrix, 𝐌 \mathbf{M} , whose diagonal elements are negative, and which are multiplied by a variable, σ \sigma , we wish to find the minimal σ \sigma such that the eigenvalue of 𝐌 σ \mathbf{M}_{\sigma} is exactly zero. By Gershgorin, we know that 𝐌 σ \mathbf{M}_{\sigma} can be made stable by making σ \sigma large enough.

arxiv-2411-13762.title: Assessing Stablecoin Credit Risks
arxiv-2411-13762.creator: Yuval Boneh, Ethan Jones
arxiv-2411-13762.description: Abstract This paper delves into the spectrum of credit risks associated with decentralized stablecoin issuance, ranging from overcollateralized lending to business-to-business credit. It examines the mechanisms, risks, and mitigation strategies at each layer, highlighting the potential for scaling decentralized stablecoins while ensuring systemic health. Keywords : Decentralized Finance, Cryptocurrency, Stablecoin, Credit, Risk 1.

arxiv-2504-05843.title: The off-shell one- and two-loop box recovered from intersection theory
arxiv-2504-05843.creator: B. Eden
arxiv-2504-05843.description: Abstract HU-MATH-2025-01 Abstract: We advertise intersection theory for generalised hypergeometric functions as a means of evaluating Mellin-Barnes representations. As an example, we study two-parameter representations of the off-shell one- and two-loop box graphs in exactly four-dimensional configuration space. Closing the integration contours for the MB parameters we transform these into double sums.

arxiv-2505-16392.title: Resource for Error Analysis in Text Simplification: New Taxonomy and Test Collection
arxiv-2505-16392.creator: Benjamin Vendeville, Liana Ermakova, Pierre De Loor
arxiv-2505-16392.description: Abstract . The general public often encounters complex texts but does not have the time or expertise to fully understand them, leading to the spread of misinformation. Automatic Text Simplification (ATS) helps make information more accessible, but its evaluation methods have not kept up with advances in text generation, especially with Large Language Models (LLMs).

arxiv-2506-01427.title: Forcrat: Automatic I/O API Translation from C to Rust via Origin and Capability Analysis
arxiv-2506-01427.creator: Jaemin Hong, Sukyoung Ryu
arxiv-2506-01427.description: Abstract Translating C to Rust is a promising way to enhance the reliability of legacy system programs. Although the industry has developed an automatic C-to-Rust translator, C2Rust, its translation remains unsatisfactory. One major reason is that C2Rust retains C standard library (libc) function calls instead of replacing them with functions from the Rust standard library (Rust std).

arxiv-2507-01527.title: A surface finite element scheme for a stochastic PDE on an evolving curve
arxiv-2507-01527.creator: Paola Pozzi, Björn Stinner
arxiv-2507-01527.description: Abstract In this paper we consider an ESFEM method for the advection and diffusion of a scalar quantity on a moving closed curve. The diffusion process is controlled by a forcing term that may include a rough term (specifically a stochastic noise) which in particular destroys the classical time differentiability properties of the solution.

arxiv-2508-14052.title: FinAgentBench: A Benchmark Dataset for Agentic Retrieval in Financial Question Answering DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: ACM International Conference on AI in Finance (ICAIF ’25); November 15–18, 2025; Singapore ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/2018/06 CCS: Information systems Information retrieval CCS: Inf
arxiv-2508-14052.creator: Chanyeol Choi, Jihoon Kwon, Alejandro Lopez-Lira, Chaewoon Kim, Minjae Kim, Juneha Hwang, Jaeseon Ha, Hojun Choi, Suyeol Yun, Yongjin Kim, Yongjae Lee
arxiv-2508-14052.description: Abstract . Accurate information retrieval (IR) is critical in the financial domain, where investors must identify relevant information from large collections of documents. Traditional IR methods—whether sparse or dense—often fall short in retrieval accuracy, as it requires not only capturing semantic similarity but also performing fine-grained reasoning over document structure and domain-specific knowledge.

arxiv-2509-10620.title: Building a General SimCLR Self-Supervised Foundation Model Across Neurological Diseases to Advance 3D Brain MRI Diagnoses
arxiv-2509-10620.creator: Emily Kaczmarek, Justin Szeto, Brennan Nichyporuk, Tal Arbel, Mila - Quebec Artificial Intelligence Institute, Canada, nichypob@mila.quebec, tal.arbel@mcgill.ca
arxiv-2509-10620.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Emily Kaczmarek, Justin Szeto, Brennan Nichyporuk, Tal Arbel, Mila - Quebec Artificial Intelligence Institute, Canada, nichypob@mila.quebec, tal.arbel@mcgill.ca. 3D structural Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) brain scans are commonly acquired in clinical settings to monitor a wide range of neurological conditions, including neurodegenerative disorders and stroke. While deep learning models have shown promising results analyzing 3D MRI across a number of brain imaging tasks, most are highly tailored for specific tasks with limited labeled data, and are not able to generalize across tasks and/or populations.

arxiv-2509-24119.title: Rationality fields of CM modular forms
arxiv-2509-24119.creator: Kimball Martin
arxiv-2509-24119.description: Abstract . We formulate a conjecture on the finitude of rationality fields (i.e., Fourier coefficient fields) of newforms of bounded degree, and prove this for CM forms assuming a generalized Riemann hypothesis. Then we explicitly determine what quadratic and cubic rationality fields occur for weight 2 CM forms, which is related to classifications of CM abelian varieties of GL(2) type.

arxiv-2601-07520.title: Factoriality and Class Groups of Upper Cluster Algebras and Finite Laurent Intersection Rings: A Computational Approach
arxiv-2601-07520.creator: Mara Pompili, Daniel Smertnig
arxiv-2601-07520.description: Abstract . We study factoriality and the class groups of locally acyclic cluster algebras. To do so, we introduce a new class of rings called finite Laurent intersection rings (FLIRs), which includes locally acyclic cluster algebras, full-rank upper cluster algebras, and certain generalized upper cluster algebras and Laurent phenomenon algebras.

arxiv-2602-23510.title: Continuous Variable Quantum Key Distribution channel emulator for the SPOQC mission
arxiv-2602-23510.creator: Emma Tien Hwai Medlock, Vinod N. Rao, Ry Render, Timothy Spiller, Rupesh Kumar
arxiv-2602-23510.description: Abstract In a free space optical (FSO) communication link from satellite to ground, the losses in the channel will be dynamic. Thus, the characterization of the FSO channel is of great importance and this can be emulated in the lab to evaluate the realistic performance of a satellite payload.

plos-pone-0008467.description: PLOS ONE research article. Viral hepatitis is a serious health burden worldwide. To date, few reports have addressed the prevalence of hepatitis A, B, C, and E in China. Therefore, the general epidemiological parameters of viral hepatitis remain unknown. In this cross-sectional study, we performed a serolo

pmc-10762358.title: Smart stimuli-responsive drug delivery systems in spotlight of COVID-19
pmc-10762358.creator: Zeinab Najjari, Farzaneh Sadri, Jaleh Varshosaz
pmc-10762358.description: The world has been dealing with a novel severe acute respiratory syndrome (SARS-CoV-2) since the end of 2019, which threatens the lives of many people worldwide. COVID-19 causes respiratory infection with different symptoms, from sneezing and coughing to pneumonia and sometimes gastric symptoms. Researchers worldwide are actively developing novel drug delivery systems (DDSs), such as stimuli-responsive DDSs.

pmc-11366908.title: Rosiglitazone retards the progression of iron overload-induced osteoarthritis by impeding chondrocyte ferroptosis
pmc-11366908.creator: Siyang Cao, Yihao Wei, Yaohang Yue, Yingqi Chen, Junyu Qian, Deli Wang, Ao Xiong, Peng Liu, Hui Zeng
pmc-11366908.description: SummaryFerroptosis is implicated in several diseases, including iron overload-induced osteoarthritis (IOOA), which is marked by oxidative stress, iron imbalance, and lipid peroxidation. Given rosiglitazone’s (RSG) ability to inhibit lipid peroxidation and ferroptosis, this study aims to assess its therapeutic potential for treating IOOA.

pmc-11473529.title: Diagnosis of fungal diseases in quinoa (Chenopodium quinoa Willd) in Burkina Faso
pmc-11473529.creator: Louis NEBIE, Abdalla DAO, Tobdem Gaston DABIRE, Schémaéza BONZI, Jacob SANOU, Irénée SOMDA
pmc-11473529.description: Quinoa is an Andean pseudo-cereal crop that is mainly cultivated for its energy and protein-rich, gluten-free seeds. Quinoa is currently being popularized in Burkina Faso, but manifestations of fungal diseases have been observed on the plants. The aim of this study was to establish a causal relationship between the observed symptoms and the associated fungal pathogens.

pmc-12500156.title: Maternity waiting homes utilization and associated factors among women who gave birth in the last one year in rural settings of Basona Worena District, Ethiopia: A cross sectional study
pmc-12500156.creator: Endale Menkir Degife, Eyosiyas Yeshialem, Abdurrahman Mahammed Ahmed, Taye Anbessie Teklemariam, Abebe Nigussie Ayel, Ermel Johnson, Ermel Johnson, Jianhong Zhou, Jianhong Zhou
pmc-12500156.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundMaternal waiting home is a residence near to health centers or hospitals that can be used as a temporary house for pregnant women for several days, while waiting for delivery reached, and a few days after labor. Most of the scholars focused on assessing the intention and knowledge of mothers to utilize maternal waiting homes for their recent delivery even though ignorance of utilization.

pmc-13186380.title: Real-time prediction of cardiorespiratory deterioration during paediatric critical care transport using interpretable machine learning
pmc-13186380.creator: Milan Kapur, Kezhi Li, Alexander Brown, Zhiqiang Huo, John Booth, Philip Knight, Gwyneth Davies, Padmanabhan Ramnarayan, Chenxi Yang, Chenxi Yang, Chenxi Yang
pmc-13186380.description: Interhospital transport of critically ill children carries inherent risks, including unexpected respiratory and cardiovascular deterioration. Early warning of impending patient deterioration may allow physicians to intervene and prevent further decline. We developed and evaluated lightweight, explainable machine learning models to forecast adverse physiological events up to 15 minutes in advance using continuously streamed vital signs and clinical data.

pmc-13317814.title: Implications of Acute Kidney Injury Requiring Dialysis Versus End-Stage Kidney Disease Status
pmc-13317814.creator: Ian E McCoy, Eugene Lin
pmc-13317814.description: More than 20% of patients receiving dialysis at in-center hemodialysis facilities initiate dialysis for acute kidney injury requiring dialysis (AKI-D) rather than end-stage kidney disease (ESKD). The transition from AKI-D to ESKD status is important to reorient clinical efforts from short-term monitoring for recovery to equally important long-term goals of establishing permanent dialysis access and planning for kidney transplant.

pmc-13404622.title: Narrative strategies in wild-mushroom-poisoning prevention videos: focus-group study among Chinese university students
pmc-13404622.creator: Yu Chen, Xinjie Zhao, Yanxi Ding, Jing Xu, Si Chen
pmc-13404622.description: BackgroundWild mushroom poisoning represents a significant global public health challenge, with China experiencing particularly high incidence rates. Despite continuous prevention campaigns by government and health authorities, existing educational videos demonstrate variable effectiveness and lack culturally adapted strategies for diverse audiences. Specifically, evidence on which narrative strategies engage young audiences across high-tradition and low-tradition cultural contexts remains limited.
